rows.question: any volunteering i can do before thanksgiving break? need hrs for my club
rows.answer:
Yes. For current community-service opportunities, check the Daily Digest, In the Loop, or Archway: [https://archway.ramapo.edu/CCEC/club_signup](https://archway.ramapo.edu/CCEC/club_signup), or contact the Civic and Community Engagement Center. [16]

You could also ask these clubs about upcoming volunteer events: Rotaract Club, which organizes volunteer projects and service events, at rotaract@ramapo.edu [2]; Project ARCH, which hosts volunteer events, at projectarchclub@ramapo.edu [1]; or the Social Work Club, which has ongoing service projects and other events, at socialwork@ramapo.edu. rows.question: anything to destress b4 finals week
rows.answer:
**General answer** (from general knowledge, not Ramapo's pages): Try a short walk, a few minutes of slow breathing, or a screen-free break to reset. Make a simple study plan with small, manageable tasks, and protect time for sleep, meals, and downtime. Connecting with a friend or doing something relaxing you enjoy can also help.

Yes. The Center for Reading and Writing is offering a free 45-minute “Study Skills to Survive the End of the Semester” workshop on November 23, 2026, from 1:15 to 2:00 p.m. online. It covers strategies for assignments and exams, time management, taking care of your health, and using campus resources. All students are welcome. Register: [https://cglink.me/2fF/r1409516](https://cglink.me/2fF/r1409516). For more information, contact Priscilla Tovey at ptovey@ramapo.edu. [12]

For a quick wellbeing check, Counseling Services offers a free, anonymous mental health screening: [https://www.ramapo.edu/counseling/mental-health-screening/](https://www.ramapo.edu/counseling/mental-health-screening/) [18]

Health Promotion suggests journaling or reflecting on your feelings, celebrating small wins, practicing self-compassion and mindfulness, and practicing gratitude. [32]

- **Center for Reading and Writing**: Phone: (201) 684-7557. Email: crw@ramapo.edu. Location: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons, Room 420. Outreach Coordinator: LC-424; Developmental Writing Specialist: LC-425; Reading Specialist: LC-423. [34]
- **Counseling Center**: Phone: (201) 684-7522. Office: D-216. [34]
